nodes.kurier.text.t: "Since you're standing about anyway, I'll tell you something I shouldn't. Yesterday a rider in a red cloak came through the gate and asked if I'd seen any survivors from the Birchgrove school. I said what I mostly see here is drunks and wolves. He believed me, because he looked like one of them himself."

nodes.raport.text.t: The commander looks over the ears tossed on the table like goods at a fair, sniffs them and pulls a face. "Wolf, not dog. I check, because once some clever bastard brought me the ears of the reeve's dog Burek." He counts out twenty-five groats with the face of a man handing over his own kidney.
